assessments.name: European Defence Fund (EDF)

rules.note: The associated countries are the EEA EFTA states (under the conditions of the EEA Agreement) and, since Regulation (EU) 2025/2653, Ukraine (under the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement).
rules.reason: Your company is established in an EU Member State, an EEA EFTA state or Ukraine. These are the Union and the associated countries of the EDF.

source.ref: Regulation (EU) 2021/697, Article 9(1) and Article 5 (as replaced by Regulation (EU) 2025/2653)
source.text:
[Regulation (EU) 2021/697, Article 9(1)] Recipients and subcontractors involved in an action shall be established in the Union or in an associated country.

[Regulation (EU) 2021/697, Article 5, as replaced by Regulation (EU) 2025/2653, Article 3(1)] The Fund shall be open to the participation of the following third countries (associated countries): (a) members of the European Free Trade Association which are members of the EEA, in accordance with the conditions laid down in the Agreement on the European Economic Area; (b) Ukraine, in accordance with the conditions laid down in the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement.

rules.title: Established in the Union or an associated country

rules.note: The same paragraph requires that the infrastructure, facilities, assets and resources used for the action are located in a Member State or an associated country for the whole duration of the action. This service does not ask about that.
rules.reason: Your executive management structures are in an EU Member State, an EEA EFTA state or Ukraine.

source.text: [Regulation (EU) 2021/697, Article 9(2)] The infrastructure, facilities, assets and resources of the recipients and subcontractors involved in an action which are used for the purposes of an action supported by the Fund shall be located on the territory of a Member State or of an associated country for the entire duration of an action, and their executive management structures shall be established in the Union or in an associated country.

rules.title: Executive management in the Union or an associated country

rules.note: The guarantees must show that control is not exercised in a way that restricts the action, that access to sensitive information is prevented, and that intellectual property stays with the recipient. Paragraph 4 of Article 9 lists them.
rules.reason: Your company is not controlled from a non-associated third country. Control from an EEA EFTA state or Ukraine does not count against you under the EDF.

source.text:
[Regulation (EU) 2021/697, Article 9(3)] For the purposes of an action supported by the Fund, the recipients and subcontractors involved in an action shall not be subject to control by a non-associated third country or by a non-associated third-country entity.

[Regulation (EU) 2021/697, Article 9(4), first sentence] By way of derogation from paragraph 3, a legal entity established in the Union or in an associated country and controlled by a non-associated third country or a non-associated third-country entity shall be eligible to be a recipient or subcontractor involved in an action only if guarantees approved by the Member State or the associated country in which it is established in accordance with its national procedures are made available to the Commission.

rules.denominator: the estimated cost of the components of the end product
rules.note: The percentage is measured against the estimated cost of the components of the end product, not against the contract value. It is a property of the end product you would supply, so the answer is about one product.

source.text: [Council Regulation (EU) 2025/1106, Article 16(10), first sentence] The cost of components originating outside the Union, EEA EFTA States and Ukraine shall not be higher than 35 % of the estimated cost of the components of the end product.

rules.note: This is a separate rule from the 35 % threshold. It is a yes or no, with no percentage.
